headline: Trump says no talks are taking place with Iran and none are scheduled
summary: US President Donald Trump said no talks are taking place with Iran and none are scheduled. He said the Strait of Hormuz remains open, while Iran said the route stays closed until Washington meets interim deal terms.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil trade, so disruption there feeds directly into crude prices and global energy markets.
why_moved: Trump said no talks are under way and Iran said the Strait of Hormuz stays closed until US terms are met, keeping shipping through the route in doubt.
